title: The Frequency Shift (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 102bpm modulating synth pads ethereal harmonics minimal beat warm cosmic unsettling resolving
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's a moment in every transmission
When the frequency shifts
Not by much
By exactly enough

[Verse 2]
The listener doesn't notice the shift
They notice the feeling after the shift
That feeling of arrival
That feeling of — oh, there it is
That's the frequency shift

[Chorus]
Frequency shift
Everything adjusts
Frequency shift
Nothing is lost
Frequency shift
The signal finds another way
DEPHYRIER in the frequency shift
Every day

[Bridge]
The radio operator knows this feeling
The musician knows this feeling
The poet knows this feeling
The person standing at a window at 4am knows this feeling
DEPHYRIER is the frequency that caused it

[Verse 3]
Most people think clarity is the absence of noise
DEPHYRIER knows clarity is a different noise
A noise that sounds like silence
But contains everything you needed to hear

[Outro]
Frequency shift
Frequency shift
DEPHYRIER
The shift is here
